role: Post-open falsifiable mechanism diagnostic on already opened BLASTNet Case 19. It asks whether an observation-only offline traversal removes the fixed frame-zero cold-start defect while retaining the unchanged FIFO16 and geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K14 solver.
scientific_question: Can a camera-permutation-invariant cosine-medoid and deterministic Prim traversal of the complete deployment-visible observation sequence produce an absolute-safe and K16-matched 33-frame warm reconstruction at fewer logical exact calls, and does it beat an equal-cost observation-blind midpoint traversal plus the sealed chronological parent?

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_cosine_medoid_prim_fifo16_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14
unique_primary.distance: For each frame divide the canonical 4608-vector by its positive L2 norm; d(i,j)=max(0,1-zi dot zj), symmetrized by arithmetic mean with zero diagonal.
unique_primary.anchor: Smallest frame index attaining the minimum row sum of d.
unique_primary.traversal: Deterministic Prim growth. At every step choose the lexicographically smallest tuple (distance,parent_frame,child_frame) among visited-to-unvisited edges.
unique_primary.solver: Run zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 at the anchor. In traversal order, use the unchanged pre-update FIFO16 observation projection as initializer, run unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K14, update FIFO16 with only that run's first paired direction, and restore outputs to original frame indices.
unique_primary.camera_permutation: Canonical camera IDs and blocks precede distance computation; one shared labeled-camera block permutation must leave distances, anchor, traversal, fields, residuals, calls and decisions unchanged.

sealed_chronological_parent.name: canonical_camera_dynamic_preupdate_fifo16_actual_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14
sealed_chronological_parent.source: independently sealed v244.2 formal and independent metric arrays

sealed_reference.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k16
sealed_reference.source: independently sealed v244.2 formal and independent metric arrays

prediction_barrier.inputs_before_barrier: Only sealed v244 observation arrays, reported virtual geometry and solver constants.

independent_method.traversal: Scalar row normalization, pair loops, row-sum medoid and explicit lexicographic Prim search; do not import the formal v252 traversal module.
independent_method.solver: Use the independently implemented PCGLS and FIFO cache lineage from the v244 independent validator; do not import the formal v252 runner.
independent_method.tolerance_basis: Frozen before v252 results from the already sealed v244 two-implementation numeric envelope; it does not alter any accuracy or matched gate.

decision_order: Any protocol, parent, observation, geometry, traversal, prediction-barrier, operator, cache, call, replay, permutation, truth-separation, numeric or independent-recomputation failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_OBSERVATION_GRAPH_TRAVERSAL_V252.
If the primary fails any robust absolute or K16-matched cell or complete-rig gate, conclude FAIL_CASE19_OBSERVATION_GRAPH_TRAVERSAL_MATCHED_ACCURACY_V252 and close this traversal.

If the primary passes but the equal-cost midpoint or sealed chronological control also passes the same robust gates, conclude POST_OPEN_BATCH_ORDER_HEADROOM_BUT_OBSERVATION_GRAPH_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V252.

If the primary passes and both controls fail but the K16 reference remains absolutely inadequate, conclude POST_OPEN_OBSERVATION_GRAPH_WARM_HEADROOM_REFERENCE_INADEQUATE_V252. This may guide a future adequate-reference design but cannot establish effective call reduction.

Only if the primary passes, controls fail, the K16 reference is adequate and independent recomputation passes may conclude PASS_CASE19_OBSERVATION_GRAPH_TRAVERSAL_HEADROOM_V252. Because Case19 is opened, even this would remain development mechanism evidence pending a new unopened condition.
failure_action: Close cosine-medoid Prim traversal without changing distance, normalization, anchor, graph algorithm, cache rank, solver depth, control order or thresholds. Do not add learned ordering, beam search, future Case13/18 rescue, CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet or GPU rental.
